description:
Framework-agnostic Spring glue (RestTemplate client adapter, Spring Security/exception modules) for the
    Jackson 3 / tools.jackson.* line. SpringSecurityModule/SpringExceptionModule implement crnk-core's Module
    interface, whose ModuleContext type differs between the crnk-core and crnk-core-jackson3 lines, so - like
    crnk-setup-servlet-jackson3 - this needs its own build even though it has no Jackson coupling of its own.
    Imports the Spring Boot 4 BOM (not 3, unlike its sibling) since this module's own source compiles directly
    against Spring Framework/Security/Data APIs that moved between the two generations, and its only real
    consumer is crnk-setup-spring-boot4.
